entry: Source-bound specific scope, traceable observed fact/explicit plan, annotated target-specific demand/supply mechanism, explicit assumptions and concrete falsifiable questions. No confirmed same-target prior bottleneck.
hold: Generic growth/expansion without target-specific link, unknown scope relationship or possible same-target prior confirmation.
exclude: Explicit incompatible scope, no factual event (rhetorical/boilerplate), invalid source references.
confirmation: Explicit same-target bottleneck is confirmation, excluded from leading research counts. Uncertain applicability remains uncertain.
unknown_policy: Keep unknown facts as UNKNOWN and research questions; do not label PASS or normalize unsupported time expressions.
objective_relation: Existing Objective Lock binding/export contract preserved. REVIEW_LEAD is a research record, not EARLY or performance evidence.
version_change: Separate review contract/rules/hash. No v2 hash, EARLY or strict change.
time: New actual review recorded time; past originals BACKFILL. No backdate or replacement of strict first-met/first_detected_at/lead time.
method: Manual source-bound annotations explicitly attributed to assistant reading, not automatic extraction or independently adjudicated performance.
storage: Immutable first record and append-only followups; distinct review identifier, no formal TARGET spoofing; no LIVE/v1/main writes.
